description: This file defines a custom exception class ConnectionFailureException used to indicate connection failures within the SMS infrastructure of the Fineract platform. The class extends AbstractPlatformServiceUnavailableException and adds constructors to handle connection name and underlying exceptions.
external_methods: AbstractPlatformServiceUnavailableException(String messageKey, String defaultMessage, String connectionName, Exception e)

classes.name: ConnectionFailureException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating a failure to connect to an intermediate server, extends AbstractPlatformServiceUnavailableException.

methods.name: ConnectionFailureException(String connectionName)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a message indicating inability to connect to the server with a specific connection name.

methods.name: ConnectionFailureException(String connectionName, Exception e)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a message and underlying cause exception for connection failure.
